faq.question: Can I combine codes?
faq.answer: Hostinger limits coupons to one per order.

faq.question: Can an existing customer use a code?
faq.answer: The official FAQ permits codes when buying new hosting plans; renewal discounts are accessed in hPanel.

faq.question: Does canceling guarantee a refund?
faq.answer: No. Cancellation and refund eligibility are separate. The VPS refund window and exclusions in the table apply; read the full policy before purchase.
